findings.title: the dispatch lane's ledger-write POSITION is unpinned: moving it to the top of commitWithhold leaves the whole 33-case dispatch integration suite green, and makes the rollback case pass vacuously

the SYSTEM halt lane adds a terminal ledger-failure path with no Sentry signal and no alerting rule row: latchSystemHalt runs under SolicitationReleasePoller, whose guarded-poll catch only calls logger.error, so attachJobFailureSink never sees it
vocabulary.ts's header is FALSE at HEAD as a direct result of this diff: it still says five exported lane maps have no production caller, and three of the five now have one
the alerting runbook attributes the disabled-ledger warning to writeRefusalEvent alone; writeRefusalEvents now emits the identical signal through the same warnLedgerDisabled()
fragile comparator: expected rows are sorted with localeCompare and compared against a Postgres ORDER BY on a uuid column, which is a different collation from the one the query establishes
evaluateAsk's already_reviewed gate has no producer, so one of the six WithholdReason members and its Refusal mapping are unreachable end-to-end through buildSolicitationBatch
